cards.stem: Which experiment was deployed on the lunar surface?
cards.quote: deployment of a solar wind composition experiment, seismic experiment package and a Laser Ranging Retroreflector.

cards.stem: What was the primary objective of the mission?
options: perform a crewed lunar landing and return to Earth
cards.quote: perform a crewed lunar landing and return to Earth.

cards.stem: Where did the Eagle land on the moon?
cards.quote: the Eagle landed in the Sea of Tranquility in Site 2 at 0 degrees, 41 minutes, 15 seconds north latitude

cards.stem: Where did Apollo 11 splash down on the return to Earth?
cards.quote: Apollo 11 splashed down in the Pacific Ocean, 13 miles from the recovery ship USS Hornet.
